newsitem.title: USA: UPS has air rights in Philippine venture.
newsitem.headline: UPS has air rights in Philippine venture.

text.p: United Parcel Service of America said it has struck a joint venture partnership with Delbros Inc and acquired air rights to the Philippines, part of its growth strategy for serving that fast-growing market.
UPS said it will be able to operate six flights a week into Manila.
It said Delbros, one of the largest transportation companies in the Philippines, has been its agent in the country since 1988.
The new air rights were granted as a result of a recent bilateral aviation agreement between the U.S. and Philippine governments.

UPS said it expects to establish two more joint ventures in the Chinese cities of Guangzhou and Shanghai within the next few months to round out the network supporting its new Asia Pacifc regional hub in Taipei. -Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
